pages.text: Check power or fuel, the capacitor slot and redstone mode. If the recipe has extra requirements, verify the tools, both reagent slots, or the XP fluid tank before moving anything.

Look in every output slot or tank. A secondary product can block the whole recipe. Pull out the result, empty the receiving storage and check the output face. A job can wait after paying its processing cost.
Try one recipe with the input and output accessible by hand. Then add the hopper or conduit again. See $(l:enderio:machines/automation)Automating Machines$(/l) for a small working layout.
